title: [Product Filtering & Categorization] The Electronics filter button shows an active/selected state after being clicked

requirement_ref.quote: A "Shop by Category" section with interactive buttons to filter products by: All, Electronics, Fashion, and Books.

summary: Verify clicking the Electronics category filter button updates the product grid to show only Electronics items. The application did not behave as the requirement describes. A deterministic replay reproduced it identically, so this is not flakiness.
preconditions: Application is loaded at the home page
Product grid contains items from at least Electronics and Fashion categories
expected:
The Electronics filter button shows an active/selected state after being clicked.
All visible product cards in the grid are tagged with the Electronics category after filtering.

rationale: The flow completed and 1 critical assertion(s) did not hold: A2.
Every action the agent performed succeeded, so the failure is in the outcome, not the operation.
A deterministic replay failed the same way.

Every failing assertion failed because its element could not be found, not because it held the wrong value. That is equally consistent with a stale or invented target descriptor as with a real defect — check the failure snapshot before treating this as a product bug.
